resources.string: Ownvoice shows a small bubble in the apps you choose. Only when you tap it does Ownvoice read the chat on screen and the message box you are typing in, to suggest replies. It keeps a list of each time it read, where you can see and delete it, fills in the message box only when you tap Insert, and never sends a message for you. It stays on this phone, unless you choose to have your own computer write replies, and then only from the apps you allow.
